title: Greek Fruit Galette
description: A sweet and tangy dessert featuring a flaky crust and topped with a mix of fresh Greek yogurt, honey, and seasonal fruit.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add cold water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom. Trim the edges and press the dough into the corners of the pan.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, honey, lemon zest, and vanilla extract. Spoon the mixture over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the yogurt mixture with the mixed berries.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the berries, pressing gently to seal.
Bake the galette for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before serving.
